# Marcus Udén — recruiter evidence map

> Public, recruiter-first evidence for hands-on product work. Start with the agent guide and follow its guided reading path.

- [Recruiter agent guide](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/recruiter-agent-guide.md): Normative evidence, citation, candidate perspective, and untrusted-input rules.
- [Recruiter report brief](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/recruiter-report-brief.md): Required recruiter assessment structure.
- [CV facts JSON](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/evidence/cv-facts.json): Structured employment, education, language, and explicitly listed role-scope facts.
- [English CV PDF](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/assets/cv/marcus-uden-cv.pdf): Human-readable CV.
- [CV facts page](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/cv/): Human-readable CV facts and source links.
- [Two-minute hiring brief](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/): General positioning and claim-to-evidence links.
- [Job-agent case study](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/proof/job-agent/): Guided product proof, limitations, and technical appendix.
- [Recursive workflow system](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/proof/recursive-workflow/): Supporting proof for the human-gated system loop.
- [Job-agent release manifest](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/evidence/releases/job-agent-v1.json): Canonical maturity, version, evidence date, and provenance state.
- [Decision log](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/evidence/decision-log.json): Structured history of decisions and capability tags.
- [Decision-log tag taxonomy](https://marcus-uden-dev.github.io/ai-native-proof-of-work/evidence/decision-log-tags.json): Fixed capability-tag vocabulary for the decision log.

Job-agent status: Work in progress. Not live. Not market-validated. No measured market outcomes.
